body.ingress: What do the Paris Climate Agreement and the European Union’s climate and energy objectives mean for the already existing building stock in Finland? Can the decarbonisation process be accelerated by the use of new and innovative solutions.
parts:
The aim of the ReCoTech Breakfast: Innovative Energy Efficiency Solutions organised by WWF in cooperation with the Finnish Association of Building Owners and Construction Clients (RAKLI) was to offer the audience an insight into new and innovative services in this field. Apart from providing a forum for a discussion with the service providers, this event was also meant to serve as an incubator for new project ideas.

This match-making event opened by Leena Oiva from WWF Finland and Anssi Salonen from RAKLI gathered more than 70 participants and the representatives of 8 companies – LeaseGreen, Senate Properties, Nordic Innovation Accelerator, Wunder, Granlund Consulting, Leanheat, Nuuka and Eneron – as speakers. The pitching session was followed by individual discussions among the participants and the solution providers who were given the possibility to keep their stands.
